verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical. Each uses a clear left-to-right banner structure with a dominant 'BEST TRX EXERCISES' headline. Both share the same flaws: the original's full-bleed photo becomes two tiny thumbnails on a mostly white canvas, so the energetic feel is lost. A loose yellow accent block overlaps the right edge of the left photo like an accidental collision. The 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' black bars are misaligned and spaced apart, and their tiny text is barely readable. The only difference is that B's yellow fragment has a slightly different shape, which is not enough to separate them.
